Add/rename/reorder a script HERE first, then re-render the CLAUDE.md table row to match -- ci_sweep.sh will hard-fail the sweep if they disagree. seed:null means the script takes no --seed (load_gate, char_creation). fixture is the fixture_save this script's own qa/scripts/<name>.json loads via title Continue (its rng_state overrides --seed when present) -- informational, not consumed by ci_sweep.sh's invocation. note is the one-line purpose column.
